title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 98
description: Ten questions on Psalms 98: a new song with harp, trumpets and ram's horn, while rivers clap and mountains sing.

questions.text: Why should a new song be sung to Yahweh, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things!"

questions.text: What has worked salvation for him?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says his right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

answers.text: His right hand and his holy arm

questions.text: In whose sight has Yahweh openly shown his righteousness?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says he has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

questions.text: Toward whom has he remembered his loving kindness and faithfulness?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says he remembered his loving kindness and faithfulness toward the house of Israel.

questions.text: Who have seen the salvation of our God, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

answers.text: No one at all as yet
All the ends of the earth

questions.text: With which instrument should praises be sung in verse 5?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says: "Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp."

questions.text: Along with trumpets, what sound is named in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says: "With trumpets and sound of the ram's horn, make a joyful noise."

questions.text: What are the rivers told to do?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says: "Let the rivers clap their hands."

questions.text: What are the mountains told to do in verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says: "Let the mountains sing for joy together."

answers.text: Bow down low to the ground

questions.text: With what will he judge the peoples, according to verse 9?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says he will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
